name: Belize
description: Belize from the Maya cities to the Baymen, British Honduras, independence in 1981 and its reefs and forests.

checkpoints.name: The Maya
checkpoints.note: Maya cities such as Caracol, Xunantunich and Altun Ha flourished in the forests.

checkpoints.name: British Honduras
checkpoints.note: Loggers from Britain cut logwood and mahogany, beat off Spain in 1798, and the land became the colony of British Honduras.

checkpoints.name: Independent Belize
checkpoints.note: Belize became independent in 1981 and protects one of the world's great reefs.
